edge_decision_groups.capability: Mechanically proven legacy raw-text dependency from a raw source through the recorded path to an expression or generation sink.
edge_decision_groups.denial_semantics: The legacy dependency is audit evidence only and grants no new runtime read capability or activation authority.
edge_decision_groups.provenance: Each edge ID binds source evidence, call path, sink evidence, and source locations in the exact candidate surface.
edge_decision_groups.quarantine: No structural quarantine guarantee is inferred for the legacy path; replacement must enforce the v4 raw-source boundary.
edge_decision_groups.quotation: No quotation capability is granted. Any future quotation path requires explicit attribution and separate acceptance.
edge_decision_groups.rationale: The exact taint path reaches an expression/generation sink and therefore requires v4 rewrite or wrapping before any activation.

edge_decision_groups.capability: No inbound raw-text read capability; the evidence is outbound response serialization or an offline restoration report.
edge_decision_groups.denial_semantics: The classification grants no runtime capability, activation, or raw-source access.
edge_decision_groups.provenance: The exact source symbols are fixed in the candidate evidence and were inspected as non-runtime inbound-read surfaces.
edge_decision_groups.quarantine: Not applicable because these findings do not establish an inbound raw external text capability.
edge_decision_groups.rationale: The parameter name is mechanically tainted but the reviewed symbol is not an inbound raw-text source-to-expression edge.

parse_error_decision_groups.denial_semantics: Import, activation, and capability approval remain blocked until the file is parseable and separately reviewed.
parse_error_decision_groups.rationale: The legacy source is syntactically unparseable, so no read capability can be inferred or approved from it.

review_statement: Technical disposition covers the exact v3 capability surface, including receiver-taint propagation and every unresolved tainted call. Separate independent human acceptance remains required.

unresolved_call_decision_groups.denial_semantics: No capability is approved; the exact unresolved call remains blocked from future activation until separately mapped and accepted.
unresolved_call_decision_groups.rationale: The tainted call crosses a legacy project-local cognition, memory, learning, state, or dynamically unresolved boundary and must be explicitly resolved or rewritten before activation.

unresolved_call_decision_groups.denial_semantics: No capability is granted and the classification cannot be generalized beyond the exact finding IDs.
unresolved_call_decision_groups.rationale: The exact reviewed call is a local value construction, deterministic transform, regex/mapping read, or temporary collection operation rather than a source-store or expression capability boundary.

unresolved_call_decision_groups.denial_semantics: The call grants no M2-B capability and remains blocked from activation until exact mapping and separate review.
unresolved_call_decision_groups.rationale: The call is an opaque dynamic, filesystem, network, process, archive, audio, queue, or output-adjacent boundary whose tainted behavior is not structurally proven safe.
